prompt:
Independently audit this contract against the indexed spec only.
Check (1) every spec segment mapped to a rule or marked unrelated/missing, (2) absent verbatim
evidence without uncertain, (3) contradictions between rule fields and examples, (4) plausible
alternative semantics with a concrete distinguishing chronological input sequence, and (5) derive
outputs for any explicit spec waveform/table/examples and compare. Report distinct material issues.
Return JSON {coverage:{Sxx:[rule IDs or "unrelated"/"missing"]},issues:[
{issue_id,rule_id (or "global"),type:"coverage"|"grounding"|"consistency"|"ambiguity"|"spec_example",
severity:"high"|"medium"|"low",detail,spec_evidence (verbatim spec or ""),alternative,sequence}]}.
Keep any deliberation brief and use short issue descriptions so the entire JSON fits. For ambiguity
the alternative must be specific; sequence must be a nonempty list of complete
width-valid nonclock input rows (optional mid) using the contract ports. For other types alternative
can be an empty string and sequence can be []. Code and prose outside JSON are not needed.
Indexed specification:
{"S01":"Given the state-assigned table shown below, implement the logic functions Y[0] and z.","S02":"// Present state y[2:0] | Next state Y[2:0] x=0, Next state Y[2:0] x=1 | Output z","S03":"// 000 | 000, 001 | 0","S04":"// 001 | 001, 100 | 0","S05":"// 010 | 010, 001 | 0","S06":"// 011 | 001, 010 | 1","S07":"// 100 | 011, 100 | 1"}
Contract JSON:
{"ports":{"inputs":{"x":1,"y":3},"outputs":{"Y0":1,"z":1},"clock":"clk"},"states":[],"rules":[{"id":"valid_y_0_to_4","outputs":["Y0","z"],"condition":"y <= 4 && Y0 == ((~x & y[0]) | (~x & y[2]) | (x & ~y[2] & ~y[0])) && z == (y[2] | (y[1] & y[0]))","edge":"combinational","visible":"same_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"Present state y[2:0] | Next state Y[2:0] x=0, Next state Y[2:0] x=1 | Output z","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"x":0,"y":0},{"x":1,"y":2},{"x":0,"y":3},{"x":1,"y":4}],"expected":[{"Y0":0,"z":0},{"Y0":1,"z":0},{"Y0":1,"z":1},{"Y0":0,"z":1}]}},{"id":"unused_y_gt_4","outputs":["Y0","z"],"condition":"y > 4 && Y0 == ((~x & y[0]) | (~x & y[2]) | (x & ~y[2] & ~y[0])) && z == (y[2] | (y[1] & y[0]))","edge":"combinational","visible":"same_cycle","priority":2,"spec_quote":"","uncertain":true,"example":{"vectors":[{"x":0,"y":5},{"x":1,"y":6}],"expected":[{"Y0":1,"z":1},{"Y0":0,"z":1}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"none","name":null,"active":"none","values":{"Y0":null,"z":null},"first_released_cycle":"not_applicable"},"mid":"Optional mid changes occur after sampling and before the other edge, carried to the start of the next row; examples use direct vectors only.","uncertain":[{"rule_id":"unused_y_gt_4","note":"The table does not list present states y=101,110,111; their Y0 and z behavior is not specified. The rule adopts one don't-care minimization candidate.","candidates":["treat unused present states as don't-cares and use minimized expressions","treat unused present states as undefined","treat unused present states as zero next-state bits with z=0","treat unused present states as all next-state bits one with z=1"]}]}
